title: Navy Blue Account: ATM Fees and Out-of-Network Usage
summary: This document explains Navy Blue ATM fees: $2.50 per transaction for domestic out-of-network (non‑Rho) ATM use; 3% of the withdrawal amount for international ATM cash withdrawals with a $5.00 minimum; and possible extra operator surcharges. It also covers monthly out-of-network rebates capped at $10 per calendar month and when fees can combine.
faqs: What fee applies when I use a non‑Rho ATM in the U.S. with a Navy Blue account?
How are international ATM cash withdrawal fees calculated, including the $5.00 minimum?
If I use an international ATM that’s also out-of-network, do I pay both the $2.50 fee and the 3% fee?
Can the ATM owner add an extra surcharge, and is it separate from Rho/Navy Blue fees?
